articles.title: Deadly strike on Kyiv warehouse prompts evacuations
articles.summary: Ukraine correspondent Dan Johnson reports from Kyiv after the deadly strike, which authorities said killed more than 30 people.
articles.body:
Nearly 400 people have been evacuated after a Russian strike on a warehouse near Kyiv killed at least 37 people, Ukrainian authorities have said.

Videos showing the moment of a huge explosion and the plumes of smoke that followed have been shared online.

The strike hit a depot storing weapons for Ukraine's military near a residential area.

An investigation into the "terrible negligence on the part of those who stored explosive right next to people" has begun, President Volodymyr Zelensky said.

Ukraine correspondent Dan Johnson reports.

articles.title: Xabi Alonso breaks silence after Chelsea star Enzo Fernandez misses Luton clash amid Man City interest
articles.summary: Football News: Chelsea midfielder Enzo Fernandez was absent from the squad against Luton Town, raising questions about his future as Manchester City eyes a potential transfer before the deadline. Coach Xabi Alonso addresses the surprising decision.
articles.body: Enzo Fernandez was left out of Chelsea's squad for Thursday night's Carabao Cup meeting with Luton Town, adding another layer of uncertainty to the midfielder's future at Stamford Bridge just days before the transfer deadline. The decision came despite Fernandez having reportedly trained well and been expected to feature against the League One side, while Manchester City continue to be linked with a move for the Argentina international. With Chelsea understood to value the 25-year-old at £120 million, Xabi Alonso was asked to explain the decision shortly before kick-off.Why was Enzo Fernandez left out?Fernandez's omission was particularly notable because Alonso had indicated before the game that the midfielder had trained well and was expected to be involved.Instead, Fernandez was not included in the squad for Chelsea's second-round Carabao Cup tie against Luton, with his absence coming as Manchester City reportedly consider making a move before Tuesday's transfer deadline.Speaking to Sky Sports before kick-off, Alonso was asked directly about the decision.He said: "We assessed situations, individual and collective, and we have decided he is not in the squad for today."The Chelsea head coach was then asked whether he wanted greater clarity over Fernandez's situation, but stopped short of offering any indication that the midfielder would remain at Stamford Bridge."Let’s see. We need to be prepared for everything. Today is focusing on the game," Alonso said.According to Argentine journalist Gastón Edul, negotiations between Chelsea and Manchester City are ongoing, with Fernandez's absence understood to be connected to discussions over his potential departure.Manchester City move remains possibleFernandez's future has become one of the more significant late-window questions around Chelsea, with Manchester City reportedly expected to test the Blues' resolve before the deadline.Chelsea are thought to be seeking £120 million for the midfielder, who joined the club from Benfica and remains under contract at Stamford Bridge.City have already spent more than £200 million reshaping their midfield this summer following the departures of Bernardo Silva and Rodri, bringing in Elliot Anderson and Ayyoub Bouaddi. A move for Fernandez would therefore represent another major investment in an area of the squad that has undergone significant change.There is also a personal connection behind the reported interest. Manchester City manager Enzo Maresca worked with Fernandez during his time as Chelsea boss and is understood to be keen on being reunited with the Argentine in Manchester.Fernandez had already spoken about leaving ChelseaThe current uncertainty is not entirely new.Fernandez first raised the possibility of leaving Chelsea in March during the final weeks of Liam Rosenior's brief spell in charge. In a series of interviews with foreign media, he spoke positively about the prospect of joining Real Madrid.That particular route appears to have closed, however, with Real Madrid reportedly insisting they have "no intention" of signing Fernandez and choosing to protect their relationship with Chelsea.The midfielder has therefore remained at Stamford Bridge despite the speculation, making his sudden omission from the squad against Luton particularly significant given the timing of the transfer window.Chelsea also making changes elsewhereWhile Fernandez's future dominates the immediate headlines, Chelsea are also continuing to work on their squad before the deadline.The club have reportedly agreed a £7.5 million deal to sign Aston Villa goalkeeper Emiliano Martínez, with The Guardian reporting that the 33-year-old is set to move to Stamford Bridge on a two-year contract with an option for another year.The move comes after Robert Sánchez endured a difficult opening Premier League game against Fulham, when Chelsea began Alonso's league tenure with a 3-2 victory at Craven Cottage.Martínez has also been linked with a departure from Villa after the club signed Japanese goalkeeper Zion Suzuki, creating an opening for Chelsea to bring in the experienced Argentina international.For now, though, Fernandez is the bigger unresolved issue. Chelsea have set a substantial asking price, City have already invested heavily in midfield and Alonso's decision to leave the Argentine out of the squad, coupled with his carefully worded explanation, has only intensified the uncertainty as the deadline approaches.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Bradley Barcola could take special Liverpool shirt number with deeply personal FIFA story behind it
articles.summary: Football News: In an unexpected twist, new Liverpool signing Bradley Barcola reveals a deeply personal story behind his choice of the No. 29 shirt, inspired by FIFA's Alex Hunter. This article explores the significance of this number and his potential arrival from PSG worth £120 million.
articles.body: Bradley Barcola is expected to take a shirt number at Liverpool that carries a rather unexpected meaning if his proposed move from Paris Saint-Germain goes through.Liverpool are reported to have reached an agreement in principle with PSG for the 23-year-old forward in a deal worth £120 million, which would make him the club's second-most expensive signing ever behind Alexander Isak. Barcola scored 14 goals in all competitions for PSG last season, and if the transfer is completed, attention will quickly turn to which number he chooses to wear at Anfield.Why Barcola could wear No. 29 at LiverpoolThere are several numbers available at Liverpool, including No. 11 following Mohamed Salah's departure, as well as 13, 16, 17, 24, 26 and 27.Barcola, however, is expected to stick with the number that has followed him throughout his professional career: 29.If that happens, he would become the first Liverpool player to wear No. 29 since Arthur Melo during the 2022-23 season.The reason behind Barcola's attachment to the number is far more personal than a typical shirt-number preference. In an interview with French publication Club Legacyz last year, the former Lyon winger explained that his love for No. 29 actually began while playing FIFA as a youngster, specifically through the game's story mode featuring fictional footballer Alex Hunter."It’s actually a funny story," Barcola said. "When I was younger, I used to play FIFA. In the story mode with Alex Hunter, this number became symbolic for me. I thought to myself: “The day I go pro, it’ll be number 29.”"And here I am, I adopted it, and now I’ll never let it go."That makes the number more than just a squad-number choice for Barcola. It dates back to a fictional career he followed in a video game before he had even become a professional footballer himself, and he has since carried that number into his real career.Barcola's celebration has a meaning tooThe No. 29 is not the only part of Barcola's footballing identity that has a personal story behind it.The Frenchman regularly points his fingers towards the sky after scoring, and he has previously explained that the gesture is his way of expressing gratitude."Every player has their own way of celebrating, and for me, it’s by pointing my fingers to the sky," he said. “I thank god for everything he’s given me. It’s my way of paying homage to him every time I score."Iraola keeps quiet on Liverpool's transfer plansLiverpool head coach Andoni Iraola was asked about the club's pursuit of a wide player ahead of Saturday's meeting with Nottingham Forest, but he refused to discuss Barcola specifically while the forward remains a PSG player.“As you know, we are trying to sign in that position. We can't talk about players who right now aren't ours. But we are trying to improve and fill that position as we don't have the numbers."I hope we have good news soon but we are still not there.”Iraola admitted that even he does not yet know how the final days of the transfer window will unfold.“I don't know what's going to happen. Even myself, I have to be patient. Then we get to September 2, this is who we have and the options we have, then we can start thinking.“For now we don't know. I have in my head what I want, we've been talking since the beginning with the club, they know what we want. It's about closing the deals.“There are certain things we can but it's true we need players in the wide areas. I'm sure if we can improve other areas we will but I don't know how the market is going to finish."With the deadline approaching, Iraola acknowledged that the uncertainty is difficult even from inside the club.“I have to be patient as well as you. It's very uncomfortable for me as you are dealing with uncertainties all the time. In four or five days we will know what we have and then we can make proper plans.”If Liverpool do complete the deal for Barcola, the Frenchman could therefore arrive at Anfield with a £120 million price tag and a familiar No. 29 waiting for him — a number he chose years ago because of a fictional footballer in FIFA's The Journey, long before he knew where his own professional journey would take him.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Watch: Sir Jim Ratcliffe and Omar Berrada's reaction to Man Utd's Champions League draw goes viral
articles.summary: Football News: Sir Jim Ratcliffe and Omar Berrada's amusing reactions during Manchester United's Champions League group stage draw have gone viral, showcasing their serious expressions as the team prepares for daunting fixtures against Bayern Munich, Atletico Madrid, and Roma.
articles.body: Sir Jim Ratcliffe and Omar Berrada may not have said a word when Manchester United's Champions League opponents were revealed, but their faces appeared to tell a story of their own.The United co-owner and chief executive were both in Monaco for Thursday's league phase draw, where Michael Carrick's side discovered a demanding set of fixtures for their return to Europe's elite competition. Cameras quickly picked up the pair's reaction as the draw unfolded, with Ratcliffe raising his eyebrows and Berrada appearing similarly serious, prompting plenty of amusement from United supporters online.The reactions quickly made their way around social media, with one fan writing, "They look stressed," while another joked, "When you realise your team is not prepared for the Champions League."A third supporter focused on United's defensive options, writing, "Ratcliffe and Berrada looking worried about the Shaw/Amass rotation against the big boys," while another added, "Omar Berrada already thinking of Olise vs Luke Shaw." A fifth simply concluded: "Omar Berrada looked really worried when he saw our draw."Whether the expressions actually reflected concern or were simply the natural reaction to a difficult draw, United certainly have some major European nights ahead.Bayern Munich, Atletico Madrid and Roma await UnitedUnited will begin their Champions League campaign at Old Trafford against Bayern Munich, bringing another meeting with the German giants to Manchester three years after their last encounter, when Bayern came out on top.The home schedule also includes Roma, RB Leipzig and Sabah, while United will travel to face Atletico Madrid, Sporting CP, Villarreal and Como.Their full league-phase fixture list is:Bayern Munich — homeAtletico Madrid — awayRoma — homeSporting CP — awayRB Leipzig — homeVillarreal — awaySabah — homeComo — awayUnited earned their Champions League return by finishing third in the Premier League last season, a major turnaround after their disastrous 15th-place finish in 2024-25.Their previous appearance in the competition came in 2023-24, when Erik ten Hag's side finished bottom of their group after taking only one victory, against Copenhagen. They drew once and lost their other four matches, leaving them with a disappointing early exit.This time, the format is different. United need to finish in the top eight of the 36-team league phase to go directly through to the last 16. Teams finishing ninth through 24th will enter the knockout phase play-offs, while those finishing 25th or lower will be eliminated.Berrada is looking forward to BayernWhile Ratcliffe and Berrada's expressions provided the entertainment, Berrada's actual assessment of the draw was considerably more positive.Asked about United's return to the Champions League, the chief executive told reporters: "We’re very excited.""This is a competition that we think we need to be playing in every season. We have some fantastic opponents."Berrada also pointed to Old Trafford's history in the competition and expressed hope that United can give supporters another memorable European campaign."Old Trafford has been the home of some great moments in this competition, so hopefully we’ll create new memories for our fans."When asked which fixture he was particularly looking forward to, Berrada immediately picked the visit of Bayern Munich."I think Bayern Munich at home.""Obviously, the 1999 final was iconic in the history of the club. But we’re looking forward to playing against all these great opponents, at home and away. And as I said, hopefully we’ll create some really good memories for our fans."Berrada also stressed that United's ambitions extend beyond simply making up the numbers in the competition, with the club targeting a deep run and ultimately aiming to win the Champions League.Sabah's remarkable route into the Champions LeagueOne of United's less familiar opponents will be Sabah, the Azerbaijan Premier League champions who will make their debut in the Champions League league phase.The club did not even exist nine years ago, making its arrival in Europe's premier competition particularly remarkable, but its qualification was anything but straightforward.Sabah appeared to be heading out during their play-off tie against Israeli side Hapoel. After losing the first leg 1-0, they found themselves 2-1 down in the second leg with only 20 minutes remaining.Then the game completely turned on its head.Umarali Rakhmonaliev pulled one back late on before Tellur Mutallimov struck again to force extra time. Hapoel were subsequently reduced to nine players, allowing Sabah to take control and finish the job.They eventually won 5-2 on the night and 6-4 on aggregate, completing an extraordinary turnaround and booking their place in the Champions League league phase.That means Sabah will now travel to Old Trafford, while United will have the chance to test themselves against some of Europe's biggest clubs at the same time. For Berrada, at least, there is no shortage of excitement; for the supporters watching their executives' reactions to the draw, there is also a rather entertaining reminder that the Champions League is not going to give United an easy ride.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Champions League 2026/27 fixtures, dates, schedule, format and who has qualified from Premier League and around Europe
articles.summary: Arsenal will play both Real Madrid and Bayern Munich in the league phase of this season's Champions League; Liverpool will travel to Inter Milan, while both Man City and Aston Villa will host holders PSG; the first round of games will be played September 8-10
articles.body:
Last season's European finalists Arsenal will play Real Madrid and Bayern Munich in this year's Champions League league phase.

The Premier League champions will also face Borussia Dortmund and Napoli in their bid to finish in the top eight automatic places, having topped qualifying with a perfect record last term.

Meanwhile, both Man City and Aston Villa will host holders PSG. The Villa Park fixture will be a repeat of the recent Super Cup, which PSG won 2-1 in Salzburg .

Among Liverpool's fixtures is a trip to Inter Milan and another tie against Atletico Madrid, with Man Utd also scheduled to face Diego Simeone's side.

Knockout-phase play-offs: February 16/17 and 23/24 Round of 16: March 9/10 and 16/17 March 2027 Quarter-finals : April 6/7 and 13/14 Semi-finals: April 27/28 and May 4/5 Final: 5 June 2027 - Wanda Metropolitano Stadium, Madrid

A total of 36 teams will enter the competition at this stage after 29 qualified at the end of last season. The remaining seven places were determined by the qualifiers.

In the new format, which is entering its third season since being implemented, teams now play fixtures against eight different teams - two teams from Pots 1, 2, 3 and 4.

Half of the eight league-phase matches are at home, with the other half away.

The top eight sides in the league will qualify automatically for the round of 16, while teams finishing 25th or lower are eliminated and do not drop into the Europa League.

The teams finishing in ninth to 24th place compete in a two-legged knockout-phase play-off. Teams finishing between ninth and 16th are seeded, meaning they will face a team in 17th-24th with the return leg at home.

The eight clubs who win their knockout-phase play-off each meet one of the seeded top-eight finishers in the league-phase table for a place in the quarter-finals.

The draw for the two-legged knockout-phase play-offs is yet to be determined.

The final will take place at the Estadio Metropolitano in Madrid, Spain, on June 5 2027.

articles.title: Tom Finney's The Splash: Why iconic image continues to resonate
articles.summary: In 1956 a football photographer captured a moment in time that is still adored 70 years later.
articles.body:
A dramatic sporting moment frozen in time 70 years ago remains as popular as ever with football fans, and even inspired a statue.

One of the finest players of his era - Tom Finney of Preston North End - was photographed during a deluge at Chelsea's Stamford Bridge in August 1956.

Like a water-skier cutting through the wake of a speedboat, Finney somehow manages to stay upright and in control.

These days, there is little doubt that top-flight referees facing similar conditions would abandon the match.

But in August 1956, the Football League first division game - the equivalent of the Premier League - continued and the players were expected to roll their sleeves up and get on with it.

Decades before the advent of digital cameras and images appearing on readers' screens within minutes of them being taken, the photographer who captured The Splash would also have had no idea of how amazing a picture he had just taken.

That would only have emerged later in the eerie light of a darkroom as his roll of film was developed.

Finney had already played for England at two World Cups (in 1950 and 1954) and was a household name - the David Beckham of his day.

So many eyes - and photographers' lenses - would have been trained on him that wet late summer's day in 1956.

Marauding down the right wing, Finney slipped and slid through a massive puddle, sending water high into the air.

John Horton was there for the Press Association, which supplies photographs to media organisations around the country.

He somehow managed to catch Finney's wave perfectly.

As one auction house which sells replicas of the image later put it: "Even though he was sliding in a sea of water, Finney still managed to maintain control of the ball.

"The photograph has become symbolic of football's gritty, old-fashioned spirit, and it captures the essence of Finney as a player: resilient, skilful, and unwavering, no matter the conditions.

"It symbolises the tenacity and adaptability of players in the 1950s, who often played through difficult conditions that would see modern matches postponed."

Finney, a one-club man who resisted offers to leave his beloved hometown team, only ever earned a maximum of £20 per week (about £400 in today's money) because of Football League rules capping wages at the time.

To boost his income, the future knight of the realm famously continued to combine his football with being a plumber.

A year after he was demobbed as a tank driver in World War Two, Finney made the first of his 433 appearances for North End and went on to score 210 goals.

For England, he won 76 caps and found the net 30 times. His final World Cup appearance came in 1958.

At 31, Preston fan Jack Bridge is of course way too young to have ever seen Finney in action.

While Jack has watched a handful of videos, it is The Splash which holds a special place in his heart.

"I think of my Grandad, who used to tell me stories about him and how if he wasn't playing people would leave the ground.

"That photograph is iconic of a man who is a Preston icon - when he died [in 2014 at at the age of 91] the crowds were five deep lining the streets."

Finney said he was surprised by how much attention the photograph received at the time and in the years that followed.

The picture has been reprinted in countless football magazines and books and even adorned the Preston North End's manager's office, T-shirts and mugs.

And when Finney appeared on ITV's This Is Your Life programme, The Splash provided the backdrop.

When North End redeveloped their Deepdale stadium in the 1990s it was clear that a stand would be named after him.

There was also a desire for a statue to be built in his honour.

Local sculptor Peter Hodgkinson said he had no doubt what it should look like.

"There's not a pub in Preston that doesn't have this picture on the wall," explained the 61-year-old PNE fan.

His statue was finished in 2002, complete with fountains as a way of recreating the iconic photograph.

"It was a challenge on many levels," Hodgkinson recalled.

"I was very young at the time and all I had to work on was some grainy photocopies.

"These days it would have been a lot easier."

Looking back on his work, Hodgkinson said: "I always think I can do better but I am proud of it as a fan."

Hodgkinson, who met Finney after the statue was unveilved, said: "He was a very humble man and was a bit overwhelmed that a statue had been created in his lifetime."

Horton, who was 82 at the time, could not attend the event but he was said by his son to have been "flattered" and "amused" by all of the attention his photograph was continuing to receive so many years after it had been taken.

articles.title: Harrison Armstrong: Nottingham Forest bid £40m for Everton teenager
articles.summary: Nottingham Forest launch an ambitious bid to sign Everton's teenage midfielder Harrison Armstrong.
articles.body:
Nottingham Forest have launched an ambitious bid to sign Everton 's teenage midfielder Harrison Armstrong.

Forest are keen to strengthen before the end of the transfer window and, as reported by The Athletic, are preparing to offer £40m plus a potential sell-on clause to clinch a deal for Armstrong.

It would be a major surprise should Everton sanction a deal, but there is hope at Forest that they can pull off the move to prise away the elegant England under-19 star, who is regarded as having a big future ahead of him.

Armstrong, 19, has made 23 appearances for Everton and started in their 2-0 Premier League win against Crystal Palace last week.

As yet, there are no indications as to whether Everton will agree to sell.

The England Under-19 international was named in the starting XI for Saturday's Premier League match at Bournemouth (15:00 BST).

Losing Armstrong would be hard for fans to stomach - analysis

The Friedkin Group, Everton 's American owners, will be risking the fury of their own fanbase should they agree to the sale of Harrison Armstrong to Nottingham Forest .

The notion that Everton could even consider parting with Armstrong sparked an instant reaction of disbelief and anger among supporters, with the teenager regarded as their brightest home-grown prospect for years and a big hope for the future.

As yet, there are no indications that Everton will accept an offer, but Forest's interest is real, although it would be a real coup should they pull it off.

It would also send out worrying signals about the scale of TFG's ambitions.

Manager David Moyes has been frustrated by the club's lack of incoming transfer activity this summer.

Moyes made it abundantly clear after Wednesday's 4-0 Carabao Cup second-round win at Championship side Preston that he wanted reinforcements.

His hope was that TFG would provide backing for further arrivals.

Since then, however, Everton 's main creator Iliman Ndiaye has been heavily linked with Manchester City , and now Forest are ready to test their resolve over Armstrong.

How Moyes would view, or indeed explain, such a sale, would be intriguing. It would appear totally at odds with his stated intention of building a better squad.

And while Everton and their support may have to accept their prize assets being spirited away by clubs such as Manchester City , the idea that their most promising young player could be taken away by Nottingham Forest – a club they would be expecting to challenge or even surpass – may be harder to stomach.

That is why the manner in which Everton handle Forest's approach for Armstrong, who has already excelled this season, may be a defining moment for TFG and Moyes.

articles.title: El calendario del Madrid en la Champions: la ruta al Metropolitano se abre ante el Inter en el Bernabéu
articles.standfirst: Acaba ante el Shakhar en Londres
articles.summary: Acaba ante el Shakhar en Londres
articles.body: El 8 de septimbre. Martes. A las 21.00 horas. En el Bernabéu. Y con el Inter como rival. Ese es el punto de comienzo de la Liga de Campeones para el Real Madrid. Una ruta que tiene su parada final también en Madrid: el 5 de junio, en el Metropolitano. La vuelta de Mourinho a la Champions con el Madrid será ante el Inter, el equipo al que en 2010 condujo a su última Copa de Europa al derrotar al Bayern por 2-0 en el Bernabéu. Aquel fue también su último partido al frente del conjunto italiano antes de convertirse en entrenador del Real Madrid. No es la primera vez que el equipo blanco arranca la Champions ante el Inter. El actual campeón de la Serie A fue el rival con el que el Madrid regresó a la máxima competición continental después de ganar la Séptima en Ámsterdam. Aquel partido se disputó en el exilio de Sevilla, consecuencia de la sanción impuesta al club tras el derribo de una portería en las semifinales ante el Borussia Dortmund. Después del duelo ante el Inter, la Champions se detiene durante más de un mes a causa del largo parón de selecciones. El 14 de octubre se reanudará el camino del Madrid. Y su rival será también italiano: la Roma, en el Olímpico. Otro reencuentro para Mou. Anres del segundo paró por la Natiosn aparecen dos jornadas más. El 21 de octubre, el Leizpig vistará la Castellana, el ex equipo de Diomande. El 4 de noviembre el Madrid regresa a Atenas. La temporada pasada ganó 3-4 al Oluympiakos y esta vez su rival era el AEK. A partir de ahí, la Champions entra en velocidad de crucero. El 25 de noviembre llega el PSV a Madrid. Ese partido despertará el recuerdo de la semifinal de 1988, el momento en el que el Madrid de la Quinta estuvo más cerca que nunca de ganar la Copa de Europa. El 9 de diciembre el viaje del Madrid será a la casa de su verdugo hace dos temporadas: la del Arsenal, con la herida de los dos golazos de falta de Rice para el actual subcampeón de Europa. En la liguilla, el último rival que pase por el Bernabéu será el Linz. El campeón austriaco, tras su gran remontada ante el Celtic, jugará en Chamartín el 19 de enero. Y el cierre del Madrid será en la casa de Xabi Alonso. Porque Stamford Bridge, estadio del Chelsea, ha sido el elegido por los ucranianos del Shakhtar para jugar como local al ser imposible hacerlo en su país por una guerra que dura ya más de cuatro año. articles.standfirst: El 27 de enero acabará la fase liga en el Metropolitano ante el Fenerbahce
articles.summary: El 27 de enero acabará la fase liga en el Metropolitano ante el Fenerbahce
articles.body: El Atlético de Madrid ya conoce el camino en la fase liga de la Champions. La UEFA hizo oficial el calendario de los ocho partidos que el conjunto rojiblanco debe disputar antes de llegar a las eliminatorias. El conjunto de Simeone se desplazará a Anfield para iniciar su recorrido en esta Champions. La temporada pasada ya se midieron en este mismo escenario con victoria inglesa por 3-2. Tras el parón por selecciones llegará la segunda jornada. El Metropolitano se vestirá de gala para recibir a un rival de enjundia en Europa: el Manchester United. La siguiente salida para el Atlético no será fácil ya que el Stuttgart será su oponente y los alemanes en su campo son especialmente peligrosos. La cuarta jornada pondrá a prueba al Metropolitano con la presencia del Bayern, uno de los grandes favoritos para conquistar esta Champions. Repetirá en casa el Atlético en la quinta jornada recibiendo al Viking noruego antes de afrontar dos salidas comprometidas ante PSV Eindhoven y Bodo/Glimt. La dificultad de esta salida es la fecha en la que se celebra (19 de enero) y las bajas temperaturas que deberá soportar el conjunto rojiblanco. La última jornada de esta fase liga será en el Metropolitano ante el Fenerbahce, un rival que se ha reforzado con jugadores bien conocidos en la liga española como Greenwood y Muriqi.

articles.body: El Villarreal afronta con ilusión y con ganas de revancha esta edición de la Champions. Tras su mala actuación de la pasada temporada ya conoce el calendario que le espera en esta fase liga. El debut de los amarillos en Europa será en uno de los grandes templos futbolísticos del viejo continente. El Dortrmund le espera siempre con un excelente ambiente en la grada. La segunda jornada supone un reto para los de Iñigo Pérez ya que reciben a un rival muy peligroso como el Nápoles. Ganar en casa debe ser fundamental para intentar acceder a los playoff. Siguiendo con los templos futbolísticos, en la tercera jornada el Villarreal visita Anfield. Una dura prueba para medir la fortaleza del conjunto español. La cuarta jornada llega a La Cerámica el actual campeón. Con el PSG se cierra un calendario infernal para el Villarreal antes de afrontar las últimas cuatro con más opciones de puntuar. En la quinta jornada se traslada a Praga con el objetivo de sumar tres puntos fundamentales y en la sexta recibe al rival más flojo de la competición, el Sabah. La visita a Estambul ante el Fenerbahce requiere de nuevo de una gran dificultad y el cierre de esta fase liga llegará en casa ante el Manchester United.

articles.title: Corberán y la falta de gol del Valencia: “Tenemos un mercado abierto para mejorar aspectos ofensivos de la plantilla”
articles.standfirst: El técnico blanquinegro evita hablar del interés de Harvey Elliott y sostiene que generar ocasiones es “responsabilidad de todos”
articles.summary: El técnico blanquinegro evita hablar del interés de Harvey Elliott y sostiene que generar ocasiones es “responsabilidad de todos”
articles.body: El Valencia juega este domingo (19:00 horas, Riazor) la tercera jornada de Liga contra el Deportivo con el objetivo de marcar su primer gol esta temporada y sumar su primera victoria en Liga. Lo cierto es que Carlos Corberán viaja con la baja sensible de Guido Rodríguez, lesionado en el cuádriceps, y de Maffeo que no se entrenó con el grupo. El técnico confirmó el regreso a la convocatoria de Dimitri Foulquier, lesionado de larga duración desde invierno, y negó que al Valencia le falte gol, aunque están buscando refuerzos ofensivos en el mercado. ¿Cómo percibe el ambiente en el vestuario y considera que el equipo ha dejado atrás las situaciones de la pasada temporada? "Si hubiera algún aspecto que me preocupase, lo hubiera señalado y lo hubiéramos corregido. El vestuario lo veo con ganas de ganar. Pienso que en los dos partidos anteriores el equipo se ha vaciado en el campo, con cosas bien hechas y con cosas que tenemos que mejorar, pero veo que la actitud del equipo y el compromiso están siendo intachables y eso es necesario para conseguir lo que todos queremos." En un mundo ideal, ¿qué posiciones considera prioritario reforzar?: "Todo lo que tiene que ver con el mercado, con nombres o con posiciones, es un diálogo, una conversación interna que mantengo con el club. Al final, de cara a reforzar la plantilla, son conversaciones que mantenemos en cuanto a necesidades, y las dejo en esas conversaciones que tengo internamente con el club". ¿Le condiciona la baja de Guido para cambiar de esquema o plantear los partidos? "Para mí, si tú haces un sistema en un año con dependencia de un jugador, está mal elegido el sistema, porque no puedes tener dependencia de un jugador para trastocar todo lo que organizativamente trabaja el equipo. Hay dos aspectos: el sistema no puede cambiar tanto que queramos, línea de cuatro, línea de cinco, atacar de una forma o de otra. No puede depender, por supuesto, de un jugador. Hay una parte que confecciona la plantilla, que es eliminar dependencias. Y otro aspecto es que juegue quien juegue, juegue al Valencia. Y eso es lo importante: que juegue un jugador o juegue el otro, mañana juegue al Valencia. Mañana hay que ver a un equipo que va al campo a ganar, esté quien esté. Y la afición tiene que ver que su equipo lo da todo por conseguir esa victoria. Que se desviven en el campo y que luchamos por conseguir lo que queremos. Y, por encima de un nombre propio, esa es la mentalidad que tenemos". ¿Qué bajas tiene el equipo y cuál es la situación de cada jugador? "Yo, a lo largo de la rueda de prensa anterior al partido de Betis, dije del sinsentido que era para mí que el Valencia jugase en agosto, la primera jornada, partido, dos días, y otro partido. Y, al final, las lesiones musculares que tenemos de Guido y de Maffeo, de los dos jugadores que están mañana fuera por lesión muscular, son la consecuencia de esa exigencia competitiva en ese momento de la temporada, en la primera semana. Y jugando no solo en desigualdad con respecto al rival por los días, es llevar al jugador a una situación límite. Como el objetivo es la victoria por encima de cualquier cosa, en ese buscar la victoria este tipo de circunstancias pueden pasar. Desafortunadamente hemos perdido dos jugadores para el siguiente partido por una lesión muscular, producida ambas en el partido. Y luego, en cuanto al resto disponible, la noticia positiva es la vuelta de Foulquier a la convocatoria. Entrenó ayer, también ha entrenado hoy y, en el momento de necesidad, en cuanto a esas bajas sensibles en alguna posición, da un paso al frente y está en disposición de ayudar al equipo, que es una buena noticia". El Valencia lleva dos partidos sin marcar aunque sí disparó mucho contra el Betis. ¿Es un problema de calidad, de acierto o de cómo se generan las ocasiones? "Marcar goles es importante, porque si no marcas goles, claramente no puedes ganar un partido. Igual que es importante defender bien y ojalá siempre consigas la portería cero, porque al menos siempre tienes un punto. En ese marcar goles hay dos aspectos muy importantes: uno es la producción ofensiva y otra cosa es la eficacia de la acción ofensiva. Y ambos aspectos responden a una responsabilidad colectiva del equipo, tanto a la hora de generar ese volumen de acciones como a la hora de finalizar esas acciones. Es un trabajo de todos, porque hay acciones que sí que van a estar más relacionadas con algunas posiciones, pero hay acciones, por ejemplo, a balón parado, que nos corresponden a todos. Y, al final, en el volumen ofensivo del equipo, tan importante es el portero, que es el primero que muchos ataques empiezan en el portero. Es el primero que, con su decisión y ejecución, permite o no que el equipo tenga una acción ofensiva. Y desde el portero a centrales, laterales, mediocentros posicionales, mediocentros ofensivos, mediapuntas, extremos y delantero. Al final es una cuestión colectiva en la que todos tenemos que dar respuesta. Hay que seguir poniendo el foco en aumentar la producción ofensiva. Y es verdad que, en la comparativa entre la jornada 1 contra el Celta y la jornada 2 contra el Betis, el equipo generó más volumen de ataque. Todavía con opciones de generar más aún, porque hay aspectos que nos hicieron perder el control por momentos. Queremos generar más volumen y es una responsabilidad de todos tener eficacia en esas acciones para poder conseguir el gol". Si pudiera elegir todas las piezas, ¿con qué sistema jugaría el Valencia? "Te diría que no hay un sistema ideal, porque no tengo en mi cabeza un sistema ideal. Lo más importante es la identidad. Estoy contento cuando mostramos como equipo la identidad que queremos mostrar: cuando el equipo tiene dominio, cuando el equipo es agresivo, cuando el equipo tiene valentía, cuando el equipo es sólido, cuando el equipo transmite principios que no tienen que ver con un sistema. Porque esos principios, esa identidad o esos valores que un equipo tiene que transmitir en el campo no hay un sistema que te lo impida o te lo permita. Los haces con línea de cuatro, los haces con línea de cinco. Lo que sí que es verdad es que la tendencia nuestra es que, cuando jugamos con línea de cinco, evitamos —pero tampoco siempre— hacer una línea pura de cinco defensas. Hasta ahora estábamos jugando con una línea de cinco donde había un mediocentro incrustado en esa línea. Y eso te permite que en ataque te quedes de cuatro, te quedes de tres, te permite hacer cosas. La línea de cinco no tiene por qué hacernos jugar de forma defensiva, porque tú puedes hacer una línea de cinco jugando con un solo central y dos laterales a sus lados. Y a lo mejor eso es más ofensivo que jugar con dos centrales y dos laterales en una línea de cuatro. Por lo tanto, por encima de cuatro o de cinco, identidad. Y trabajamos para la identidad del equipo: que el equipo sea agresivo, que el equipo sea sólido, que el equipo tenga dominio del juego y que el equipo sea valiente. ¿Lo conseguimos siempre? No, pero trabajamos para eso. Porque la afición es lo que quiero ver: esa señal de identidad del equipo en cada partido". Pepelu dijo que le falta gol al Valencia. ¿Está de acuerdo con estas palabras? "En los dos partidos anteriores nos ha faltado gol. Pero eso no nos puede llevar a una generalización de que al Valencia le vaya a faltar el gol. Tenemos jugadores con potencial ofensivo para producir más y para acabar las jugadas que producimos. No tengo ninguna duda de eso, aun siendo conscientes de que tenemos un mercado abierto donde el foco está en mejorar aspectos ofensivos de la plantilla. Pero para los que vengan y los que estamos, la responsabilidad es nuestra: generar más volumen de ataque y tratar de aumentar esa eficacia". Con la baja de Guido, ¿han trabajado especialmente la salida de balón? “Yo no veo que el equipo pueda tener problemas de salida de balón porque juegue Guido o no juegue Guido. Guido es un jugador importante en el equipo, por eso se ha puesto por él, y es un jugador que ha demostrado el nivel que tiene. Tenemos jugadores que son importantes también en el equipo, que tienen capacidades similares a las que tiene Guido. El equipo no tiene por qué renunciar a una forma de jugar que puede ser importante o puede ser diferente, en función de lo que tú eres y dónde crees que le puedes dañar más al rival. Por eso he dicho que, quien juegue mañana, el equipo está en disposición de competir y de ir a por la victoria". ¿Y qué hay de los rumores sobre Harvey Elliott, ha hablado con él? "Yo trato de no responder a rumores que tienen que ver con el mercado. Lo he dicho antes: cualquier nombre propio del que yo entiendo que el club me pregunte mi opinión, o cualquier posición que yo entiendo que el equipo necesita reforzar, lo dejo siempre a nivel de ese diálogo interno que mantengo con el club, de cara a reforzar y a mejorar la plantilla”.

articles.title: Se busca central
articles.standfirst: Ficharán un defensa joven con proyección si sale un jugador, probablemente Balde
articles.summary: Ficharán un defensa joven con proyección si sale un jugador, probablemente Balde
articles.body: A falta de menos de tres días para el cierre del mercado, el Barcelona sigue trabajando para definir la plantilla de la temporada que acaba de comenzar. Y todavía tiene varias carpetas abiertas. Una de ellas es la incorporación de un central. Deco y Flick siguen dándole vueltas. Están estudiando el mercado, pero todavía no se ha tomado una decisión definitiva. En primer lugar, porque están a la espera de que salga uno de los defensas en las próximas horas, además de Álvaro Cortés que ha sido traspasado al Amberes. Balde sigue buscando equipo al ver que, en este momento, tiene por delante a dos jugadores como Joao Cancelo y Xavi Espart. Sabe que, si se queda, va a jugar muy poco, por lo que está buscando una alternativa que todavía no llega. Si el lateral saliera, el club ficharía un central. Las dudas están en qué ocurriría si no se va ningún defensa. Flick ve que tiene muchos centrales en la plantilla, aunque alguno de ellos esté recolocado en otras demarcaciones. Es el caso de Jules Koundé y Eric García. Ambos han venido jugando en el lateral derecho, pero comenzaron su carrera en el centro de la defensa. El francés, en estos primeros partidos, ya ha jugado algunos minutos en el eje de la zaga. Además de estos dos jugadores, cuenta con Cubarsí, Christensen y Gerard Martín. Si se fuera Balde y se fichara un central, este último podría jugar, si fuera necesario, en la banda izquierda, aunque en principio parece bien cubierta con Cancelo y Espart. Y Flick tiene bastante claro que donde más le gusta Gerard Martín es como defensa central. Lo que ha decidido la Dirección Deportiva es que no será un gran fichaje. Eso ya quedó claro cuando, a principios de verano, se descartó la llegada de Bastoni, que habría sido un fichaje de unos 60-70 millones. En este momento se busca otro perfil. Quieren un jugador joven, con proyección de futuro, y no uno ya consagrado. La idea sería fichar a un futbolista del perfil de Hamza Abdelkarim o Jesse Bisiwu. Ambos están en dinámica de primer equipo y son opciones para la delantera, como se ha demostrado en la pretemporada. El central que viniera sería algo así, porque Flick tiene claro que en su plantilla están los titulares. Así que la Dirección Deportiva sigue buscando, aunque no es un fichaje prioritario.

articles.title: Football fans tribute to crash death Cleveland Police officers
articles.summary: PC Matthew Blades and PC Tom Clough died in a head-on collision on the A66 near Middlesbrough.
articles.body:
Football fans and players have paid tribute to two Cleveland Police officers who were killed in a crash on Teesside.

PC Matthew Blades and PC Tom Clough died in a head-on collision between their police car and a vehicle going the wrong way on the A66 near Middlesbrough early on 22 August. Five people in the other vehicle also died.

There was a minute's applause in their memory ahead of Middlesbrough and West Bromwich Albion's Championship match at Riverside Stadium, as pictures of the two men were displayed on a screen.

On Friday evening Hartlepool United also held a two-minute silence before their home National League game against Eastleigh.

Middlesbrough FC said in a statement prior to the match: "We are also showing our appreciation for the dedication and hard work of both men, and to Cleveland Police force in protecting and supporting our local community.

"The commitment shown by officers and staff, often in challenging and demanding circumstances, plays a vital role in keeping residents safe and helping people feel secure in their homes, neighbourhoods and local areas."

Earlier this week 17 people were arrested in connection with the investigation into the crash bringing the total number of arrests to 24.

The occupants of the other vehicle, a Passat - Michael Robert Cahill, 23, Jacob Matusiak, 23, Makai Saddington, 18, Theo Rae, 17, and Cole Robert Worthy, 17, also died.

Speaking earlier on Radio 4's Today programme, Middlesbrough mayor Chris Cooke said Cleveland Police was doing "extremely well" despite a lack of funding that "they absolutely need".

"They are a police force that has been the hardest hit.

"They've had over 10 per cent reduction in FTE (full-time equivalent) of police officers, while other places have seen over 20 per cent increase, and that isn't fair," he said.

Cooke added police funding should "follow need".

"It cannot just be based on population sizes as it currently is, because that serves no one well," he said.

articles.body:
Última hora del Levante - Betis en directo:

Muy buenas tardes. El Levante se presenta esta temporada ante su afición enfrentándose a un hueso duro de roer. El Betis de Champions visita Valencia por segunda vez en una misma semana con el objetivo de volver a llevarse los tres puntos, como hizo el martes en Mestalla, para seguir con su pleno de victorias. Enfrente, un conjunto granota que arrancó el curso con problemas, pero en El Sadar mejoró mucho su imagen el pasado lunes.

El Levante llega con las dudas de posibles salidas, como las de Carlos Álvarez o Etta Eyong , los granotas intentarán continuar con la imagen mejorada de la última jornada, al contrario de lo ofrecido en el RCDE Stadium, ante un rival al que no consigue superar en Orriols desde la temporada 2020-21. El portugués Luís Castro podrá contar con todos los jugadores de su plantilla, después de completar las inscripciones de toda su nómina, a excepción de Álex Primo que sigue recuperándose. Del mismo modo, tendrá disponible a Musuayi , que se perdió el choque en Pamplona por lesión.

En el Betis, después de conocer el complicado camino que tienen por delante en su regreso a la Champions , centran todos sus esfuerzos en una Liga que han arrancado a gran nivel. Dos victorias, ante la Real Sociedad y el Valencia, les sitúan en la zona alta de la tabla. Y a la espera de cerrar un mercado en el que buscan la manera de encajar económicamente un pivote, con el nombre de Amrabat sobre la mesa de nuevo, y el regreso de Ceballos , recuperan a una de sus estrellas, el marroquí Ez Abde , que entró en la convocatoria y que podría tener minutos si el partido se les atasca.

Enseguida tenemos novedades desde Orriols, conocemos los onces y os contamos todo lo que pase en el partido. Arrancamos.

articles.title: Real Madrid: Jose Mourinho concerned by three-week international break
articles.summary: Jose Mourinho says the three-week international break is a “concern” for Real Madrid, with several key players facing a demanding schedule after the World Cup.
articles.body:
Real Madrid manager Jose Mourinho has raised concerns about the impact of September's three-week international break, highlighting the amount of time his players will be away from their club.

"The international break does concern me," Mourinho said. "It's a lot of time."

Speaking before Sunday's home La Liga match against Malaga (16:00 BST), Mourinho said he was mostly troubled by players linking up with their nations who then do not get game time.

"Players who will join their national teams to play don't worry me as much. It's the ones who join the national teams and are not really involved that concern me," he said.

"We'll see how we can go about this and work with the rest of the players. But not having players at my disposal for three weeks is a difficult situation."

The first international break of the 2026-27 men's football season next month will last a week longer than usual, with the traditional October break now scrapped.

In recent years, Fifa has used five primary international breaks during the season, in March, June, September, October and November.

But instead of separate breaks in September and October, there will now be a three-week gap for international fixtures across late September and early October, when countries will play four international matches instead of two. The existing international breaks in November, March and June will remain.

A number of reasons are behind the change, including the 2026 World Cup final being played on 19 July, the latest date for a summer World Cup since 1966. Player welfare and travel considerations were also taken into account when the changes were made.

"I totally respect the players' decisions and I don't want to dramatise too much, but very often they pick up injuries during those breaks and right after returning from an international break," Mourinho explained.

"So it does worry me, but this is the way these things are and we can't do much about it."

The Portuguese has already spoken at length about the World Cup players in his Real Madrid squad, including Jude Bellingham, Marc Cucurella and Kylian Mbappe, who have had a demanding summer.

He said the club are working to manage their workload to reduce the risk of injury.

In his pre-match media conference, Mourinho was also full of praise for Bellingham, highlighting his importance to the team beyond his attacking contributions.

"He is a unique kind of player, extremely important for the team," said Mourinho.

"His mental strength, tactical ability, the way he recovers the ball, the way he pressures, the way he plays up front.

"We like talking about Kylian, Vini [Vinicius Jr] and Jude, but I'm really happy with all the players.

'Ballon d'Or winner doesn't have to have won World Cup'

Mourinho also gave his perspective on the Ballon d'Or debate, arguing that winning the Champions League or World Cup should not automatically make a player the favourite for the individual award.

"It's a very beautiful thing individually and that enters into the individual history of a certain player," Mourinho said.

"I think it's normal that there are a dozen players of a very high level, of which we have three or four. It is normal that it exists as an ambition."

Mourinho suggested the prize should be ultimately measured by a player's lasting impact on the game.

"For me, the Ballon d'Or has to be one of those players that when he finishes playing, we miss for eternity," Mourinho said.

"I miss Maradona, Ronaldinho, Ronaldo, Cristiano, Messi, Zizou, Lothar Matthaus - I miss these people.

"You can't give the Ballon d'Or to a player because he won the Champions League or because he won the World Cup. It doesn't have to be from Paris St-Germain or the Spanish national team."

articles.title: Giráldez: “Tengo una grandísima relación con la dirección deportiva y con la presidenta”
articles.standfirst: El técnico se centra en conseguir el primer triunfo de la temporada ante el Athletic
articles.summary: El técnico se centra en conseguir el primer triunfo de la temporada ante el Athletic
articles.body: Sobre el partido ante el Athletic, las dificultades de competir con el mercado abierto, las propias necesidades del equipo o las complicaciones en ataque, habló este sábado Claudio Giráldez. Situación del Athletic: “Quedarte con uno menos en este momento de la temporada ya es fastidiado y más si te pasa en el minuto 20 de partido, en los primeros compases, en el priner partido en casa con un entrenador nuevo, un cambio de idea de ciertas cosas aunque creo que otras lo mantiene. Ese primer partido es muy complicado poder sacarlo adelante y visitar el Camp Nou es un 0 puntos mentiroso, en mi opinión. No se fía: “Creo que tiene un auténtica plantillaza, que tiene muchos recursos para poder hacer daño, que es un equipo que va a estar en la parte alta de la clasificación sin ninguna duda y con un gran entrenador, con un gran legado que dejó Ernesto”. Competir con el mercado abierto: “Dentro de una misma situación no es lo mismo como lo afronta un jugador que otro. Hay jugadores que están más habituados o tienen más experiencia o le resbala más la información que pueda haber con respecto a su futuro y hay gente que le afecta un poco más o qué es más sentida. Probablemente ese jugador tenga un rendimiento menor y hay que intentar limitarle los minutos o esperar a que acabe el mercado para que pueda dar su mejor versión. Forma parte de nuestro trabajo tomar la decisión de quién crees que está mejor preparado para participar más o menos minutos”. Dificultades en ataque: “Cuantos más partidos tengas encima, más te atreves a dar el último pase, tiro, centro y espero que tenga razón y que poco a poco vayamos viendo esa evolución del equipo, esa verticalidad mayor y ese atrevimiento mayor en los últimos metros que es lo que nos ha faltado en estos dos partidos”. Últimos días de mercado: “Espero que haya tranquilidad. Me mantengo en lo que he opinado. A ver qué pasa en el mercado e intentar salir no debilitados, si podemos fortalecidos, y con calma. Tengo una grandísima relación con la dirección deportiva y con la presidenta. Estamos de acuerdo en el 99% de las decisiones que tomamos o casi en el 100%. Intentamos debatir como personas adultas y normales sobre lo que no estamos de acuerdo y creo que vamos de la mano desde que llegué aquí hasta ahora. Se ha malinterpretado muchas veces las situaciones que ha habido durante el mercado o las cosas que se hablan fuera de las ruedas de prensa. El club goza de una salud y de un ambiente espectacular y no me gustaría que se perdiese ni por declaraciones, ni informaciones de redes sociales, medios de comunicación y todo esto. Calma y tranquilidad y a seguir haciendo celtismo que estamos en el camino adecuado”.

articles.title: El duro proceso de aprendizaje que necesita España
articles.standfirst: La selección reúne a muchos jugadores nuevos y no ha jugado partidos de preparación
articles.summary: La selección reúne a muchos jugadores nuevos y no ha jugado partidos de preparación
articles.body: Un proverbio europeo de la Edad Media decía 'Roma no se construyó en un día', es decir, las cosas grandes e importantes no se logran de inmediato. Y eso es aplicable a la selección española de baloncesto. Analizando el talento que se ha logrado reunir, el que está disputando las Ventanas de clasificación, y el que no ha podido venir, surge la idea de que algo grande está en construcción. Pero como Roma, requiere su proceso, cuanto más controlado, mejor. Precisamente en ese camino de aprendizaje de un equipo extraordinariamente joven, incluso con algunos de sus veteranos, las lecciones más duras y complicadas pueden ser las más valiosas, las que preparen cuando lleguen momentos grandiosos y mucho más complicados. Las Ventanas FIBA ofrecen un buen muestrario de esas lecciones. Pasó ante Georgia en julio y de nuevo ante Portugal este pasado viernes. La derrota en Tbilisi fue más por cómo se produjo que por el hecho de perder. Dominar un partido en territorio hostil durante 34 minutos de baloncesto excelso, y perderlo al final con una prórroga forzada y ganada por Georgia. El partido perdido ante Portugal es diferente: había un ambiente festivo, quizá demasiado, y una peligrosa sensación de superioridad ante un rival que supo sacar provecho de la situación. De ambos tropiezos, el equipo tiene mucho que aprender para el futuro. "Es un partido propio de equipos que no están cohesionados lo suficiente", analizaba Chus Mateo al final del partido ante Portugal. "Nos faltan horas de vuelo y espero que las vayamos cogiendo poco a poco". Tiene razón el seleccionador. Hizo debutar a dos jugadores como Aday Mara y Baba Miller, y algunos jugadores llegaron con casi tres meses sin competir. Luego está la baja de Santi Aldama, un catalizador de esta selección. España, a diferencia de otros equipos, no ha jugado ningún partido de preparación (Francia y Serbia, por ejemplo, se midieron dos veces entre sí). En realidad, Chus Mateo está obligado a utilizar partidos de competición como ante Portugal y Grecia casi como preparación, porque está construyendo un equipo, a la vez que se juega la clasificación para el Mundial. Malabares sobre un alambre. Hasta ahora el camino no ofrecía obstáculos ganando los primeros partidos desde que el nuevo staff técnico se hizo cargo de la selección hace un año. Han llegado dos derrotas y algo de preocupación en el ambiente de cara a la clasificación para el Mundial. La sensación es que ante Portugal se perdió una gran oportunidad de dejar casi sellado el pase, pero la realidad es que España sigue siendo líder de su grupo y tiene ganado el average ante Ucrania y Georgia. La selección sigue con sus opciones intactas para estar en Qatar en 2027. "Tenemos que pasar página y preparar el partido ante Grecia aprendiendo de las lecciones que nos va dando este proceso", decía el seleccionador. El partido ante el equipo heleno ha cobrado un mayor dramatismo. Básicamente porque se va a acudir a la cueva de un animal, siempre peligroso, y herido de muerte. Grecia, en el OAKA, se crece ante su afición hostil, y ese será el ambiente que se encuentre la joven selección española. Más aprendizaje. Las Ventanas FIBA dan para hacer un Máster en crecimiento baloncestístico. Los griegos, tras su derrota ante Ucrania y con un vestuario incendiado, necesitan imperiosamente la victoria ante España. Perder sería desastroso y casi un anticipo a quedarse fuera del Mundial. Pero ahora España también tiene que ganar en Atenas para evitar líos y acudir a las Ventanas de noviembre en Montenegro y recibiendo a Grecia con algo más de colchón. Una derrota española tampoco sería una tragedia, como en el caso de Grecia, pero añadiría dudas y eso no es bueno. La selección necesita rodaje, ya bien sea en partidos de preparación o en las Ventanas de clasificación, como es el caso: "Los jugadores no están en la mejor forma posible para estos partidos tan importantes, pero no es excusa. Es lo que toca y tenemos que asumirlo", decía Chus Mateo. El seleccionador tiene en sus manos un equipo que es un tesoro, pero le tiene que dar forma. Ya le hemos visto jugar con la idea que tiene su arquitecto, pero conseguir que eso ocurra 40 minutos en un partido, ya es cuestión de tiempo y de madurar el proyecto. Al fin y al cabo, 'Roma no se construyó en un día'.

articles.title: Quique Ribes es la novedad en la convocatoria del Celta
articles.standfirst: El futbolista del filial suple al sancionado Marcos Alonso
articles.summary: El futbolista del filial suple al sancionado Marcos Alonso
articles.body: Claudio Giráldez facilitó la lista de 24 futbolistas para el partido de este domingo ante el Athletic, en Balaídos, en la cual la principal novedad es la presencia del futbolista del Celta Fortuna, Quique Ribes. El defensa valenciano de 22 años, que llegó hace un año a Vigo procedente del Real Madrid Castilla, se estrena en una convocatoria del primer equipo céltico ante la ausencia, por sanción, de Marcos Alonso. Además, es baja para el partido, al estar lesionado, Borja Iglesias. El último fichaje, Couhaib Driouech, aún no entra en la lista de convocados pero la intención es que el jueves ya viaje a San Sebastián cara al partido ante la Real Sociedad. El único futbolista que no entra en la lista, por decisión técnica, es Carles Pérez. En la convocatoria se mantienen los futbolistas del filial, Andrés Antañón y Hugo Burcio. Ambos, al igual que Quique Ribes, podrían jugar este lunes con el Celta Fortuna ante el Castellón, en caso de no participar con el primer equipo ante el Athletic.

articles.title: Liverpool v Nottingham Forest: How the players rated
articles.summary: How Liverpool and Nottingham Forest's players rated following their Premier League match.
articles.body:
Liverpool drew 2-2 with Nottingham Forest in Andoni Iraola's first home Premier League game as their new head coach.

Here's how I rated the players and you can see how you scored them below.

Munoz rescues point for Liverpool at home to Forest

What do BBC Sport's player ratings mean?

Alisson : Well beaten for Dan Ndoye's goal but made a superb save to deny Igor Jesus on the brink of half-time and keep Liverpool in the game. Poor penalty to give away for Gibbs-White's goal. 5

Jeremie Frimpong : Struggled defensively but got into some good positions going forward. Did really well in the build-up to Florian Wirtz's disallowed goal but was just offside. Has to improve consistency with his end delivery. 6

Jeremy Jacquet : Made a goal-saving challenge to deny Igor Jesus an early goal and was impressive but still had a few moments where he was slack and lacked discipline. 6

Virgil van Dijk : Will be furious with how easily the Liverpool backline was cut open for Ndoye's opener and the ease with which Forest won their penalty. 6

Milos Kerkez : A poor display from the Liverpool left-back and was sloppy in possession. Replaced by Kostas Tsimikas in the 71st minute. 5

Dominik Szoboszlai : Solid as usual and was much more alert defensively, compared to his display at Newcastle . 6

Alexis Mac Allister : Back in the starting XI and played a lovely reverse ball for Cody Gakpo early on. Couldn't cope physically with Igor Jesus in the build up to Ndoye's goal. 6

Cody Gakpo : Started down the right in what was potentially his last Liverpool appearance and was effective. Played a lovely ball for Wirtz, then did really well to create a chance for Victor Munoz. Didn't do his defensive duties for Forest's opener but did brilliantly to create Alexander Isak's equaliser. 7

Florian Wirtz : Constantly posed a threat and unlucky not to score, having had a neat finish ruled out as Frimpong was offside and a solid header tipped over by Matz Sels. Got the assist for Munoz's goal. 7

Victor Munoz : Made his first Liverpool start and it was down his preferred left flank. The Spaniard was direct and had a penalty shout turned down but he should have tested Sels at least when he fired a first-half effort wide from inside the box. Scored a belter to level the game in front of the Kop and rescue a point for Liverpool . 7

Alexander Isak : Just six touches in the first half and zero shots on goal but made up for a forgettable opening 45 minutes with the first equaliser on the hour mark. That was just his ninth touch but a goal that will give him plenty of confidence. 6

Subs not used: Mamardashvili, Endo, McConnell, Koumas.

Matz Sels : Was commanding and it was his punt up the field that led to Ndoye's goal. Made a great save to deny Wirtz but was well-beaten by Gakpo's cross for Isak's leveller and had no chance with Munoz's strike. 5

Jair Cunha : Strong performance but will know he should have done better for Isak's goal. 6

Nikola Milenkovic : Part of a Forest backline that initially made it incredibly hard for Liverpool to break them down. 6

Murillo : Unafraid to drive with the ball and put in a solid shift but was well beaten by Munoz for the goal that made it 2-2. Still crucial that Forest keep him. 6

Ola Aina : Relentless all game. Was very involved, as always, and constantly asked questions of Liverpool . Nearly created a goal for Forest. 7

James McAtee : Getting his chance after Elliot Anderson's move to Manchester City and was very tidy on the ball in an impressive performance. Made some really good deliveries in the first half and battled well all afternoon. 7

Xaver Schlager : The summer signing came in for the injured Ibrahim Sangare and bar getting nutmegged early on by Dominik Szoboszlai, this was a good display from the Austrian midfielder. 7

Neco Williams : Like Aina, was full of energy down the opposite flank. Made a superb tackle early on to deny Gakpo. Was once on the Anfield books, and it was interesting to hear Steven Gerrard say pre-match that Liverpool should have kept him. Had a few defensive lapses but ultimately won the penalty that put Forest ahead for the second time. 7

Dan Ndoye : A wonderful finish past Alisson in the first half for what was his first Premier League goal in 377 days. 7

Morgan Gibbs-White : Quality on the ball and got the assist for Ndoye before dispatching his second-half penalty in style. Loves Anfield and now has five goal involvements (three goals, two assists) there. No Englishman has netted more Premier League goals overall this calendar year than his 13. 8

Igor Jesus : Had a great chance early on and his hold up play was brilliant for Ndoye's goal. Caused a nuisance for Liverpool 's centre-backs all afternoon. 7

Subs not used: Victor, Diomande, Wood, Yates, Abbott.

After the opportunity to rate players has closed, the score displayed represents the average from all the submissions by BBC Sport users.

articles.title: Derby County 0-3 Swansea City: Swans cruise to away win at struggling Rams
articles.summary: Report and free match highlights from the Sky Bet Championship match between Derby County and Swansea City at Pride Park on Saturday; Joseph Opoku, Ji-Sung Eom and Ronald score in comfortable Swans win.
articles.body:
Opoku netted for the second time following his summer move from Belgian outfit Zulte Waragem, while Eom - the architect of that opener - then got on the scoresheet himself just before half-time with only his second league goal since November. Ronald added a deserved third in second-half stoppage time.

The routine victory meant Vitor Matos' men have collected seven points from a possible nine, while out-of-sorts Derby are still waiting for their first win of the new campaign.

Earlier, Ryan Hedges had the ball in the net for the hosts after just 18 seconds, but that was the nearest John Eustace's men would get to the Swansea goal during a sluggish opening half-hour in which they did not muster a single shot that counted.

The visitors, meanwhile, struck from for their first attack in the second minute. Eom was allowed to run unopposed with the ball through the left channel before pulling the ball back for Opoku, whose deflected 12-yard drive spun into Jacob Widell Zetterstrom's bottom-right corner.

The Ghanaian attacker almost added a second when his acrobatic volley just cleared Zetterstrom's crossbar following Stephen Welsh's floated ball into the six-yard box.

Derby will have been relieved to see Opoku exit the action midway through the half due to injury. But the Swans continued to threaten down the right, with Zetterstrom unconvincingly spilling a Melker Widell shot to safety and Adam Idah flashing a far-post effort wide.

The Rams finally offered a response but Max Johnston could only find the side-netting from an unfavourable angle and Eom made it 2-0 in the 44th minute.

The South Korea international followed up to roll the ball into an unguarded net from a yard out after Zetterstrom had saved well down to his right to keep out Idah's header from Widell's right-wing cross.

An unhappy Eustace made a triple substitution at half-time and Derby briefly rallied, with Lewis Travis and Charlie Taylor both seeing long-range attempts deflected away from goal.

But soon afterwards, Zetterstrom made two saves to keep his team in the contest. First, Swans sub Zan Vipotnik should have done better when he shot straight at the Swedish international after Moussa Yeo had combined brilliantly down the left wing with Eom.

Then, Zetterstrom kept out a near-post Yeo drive after Lawrence Vigoroux's long forward punt had sent him sprinting clear through the right channel far too easily.

Ronald went on to wrap up matters when he fired into Zetterstrom's bottom-right corner from the edge of the box after Stephen Eustaquio's shot had been blocked.

Toothless Derby were booed off at the final whistle, having failed to score for the first time in 24 league games at Pride Park - a run stretching back to last September.

"I can understand the fans' frustrations 100 per cent because the performance was unacceptable and I'm really disappointed," he said.

"We are lacking in confidence at the moment so conceding that first goal so early on didn't help, and while we huffed and puffed and had some little moments, to then concede the second just before half-time was a kick in the teeth.

"We then made three changes at half-time. I didn't want to because none of the players are fit yet and that showed with the way we dropped off the pace in the final 20 minutes, but we had to try and make something happen.

"We couldn't really put together any sustained attacks or give their keeper any problems, though, and things just seemed to fizzle out a bit and we're probably lacking a bit of quality in certain areas, which we are crying out for.

"The only thing that disappointed me in the second half was that the body language of some players wasn't great. But I'll take full responsibility for the performance and result. I pick the team, coach the players and give the tactics out."

"We started the game really well and scored. There were moments when Derby pushed us back but we coped with their threat, and after we scored the second goal that gave us the comfort to control the game how we like to.

"Derby made a really strong start to the second half and pushed us back again, but we stayed controlled and calm and then had a number of chances to score. We were maybe a bit too anxious to get a third to kill the game off but I'm really pleased with the maturity of the team, how the new players are fitting in and the desire and energy they are showing.

"We have a group of players who are enjoying playing together. We have the same mindset whether we're playing home or away and we're happy to have put on a good performance for our fans.

"We're showing we can compete against teams with different styles of playing, but it's only one game and we have a difficult run of fixtures coming up."

articles.title: El Como ficha a Ricci: competencia para Luis Milla y un italiano más para cumplir el cupo
articles.standfirst: El centrocampista llega cedido desde el Milan para apuntalar la medular de Fàbregas
articles.summary: El centrocampista llega cedido desde el Milan para apuntalar la medular de Fàbregas
articles.body: El Como de Cesc Fàbregas sigue dando forma a su plantilla para afrontar una temporada histórica, la del debut en la Champions League. El último en aterrizar ha sido Samuele Ricci, que llega cedido desde el Milan con una opción de compra de 22 millones y refuerza una posición en la que el conjunto italiano ya había incorporado a Luis Milla. El futbolista, de 25 años, fue fichado por el conjunto 'rossonero' el pasado verano procedente del Torino a cambio de 23 kilos. En una plantilla repleta de centrocampistas de primer nivel, como Modric y Rabiot, su presencia como titular se vio limitada, aunque disputó 31 partidos en la competición doméstica. Ahora afrontará un reto mayúsculo con el conjunto lombardo. La llegada del centrocampista italiano también responde a la necesidad dentro de la planificación de la plantilla. El Como suma así otro futbolista italiano al equipo, un aspecto a tener en cuenta para cumplir con los requisitos establecidos por el reglamento de la Serie A. La normativa exige que los clubes cuenten con un mínimo de cuatro jugadores formados en Italia y cuatro formados en el club que, entre los 15 y los 21 años, hayan estado inscritos en él durante al menos 36 meses o tres temporadas completas, sin importar su nacionalidad. El Como cuenta actualmente con seis futbolistas italianos, por lo que la incorporación de Ricci permite reforzar un apartado que ha sido objeto de críticas en el propio país. La lista la completan Vigorito, cuarto portero; Goldaniga; Liberali, fichado este verano; y las vueltas tras cesión de Dossena y Mazzitelli, este último sin dorsal.

articles.title: Dituro: "Me duele en el alma no haber estado a la altura"
articles.standfirst: El argentino pide disculpas por su error en la derrota del Elche ante el Racing
articles.summary: El argentino pide disculpas por su error en la derrota del Elche ante el Racing
articles.body: El portero argentino del Elche, Matías Dituro, pidió disculpas en las redes sociales por el grave error que cometió este viernes en el primer gol encajado por su equipo en la derrota ante el Racing de Santander (3-2) en El Sardinero. "Siento mucho el error que cometí en el primer gol, y me duele en el alma no haber estado a la altura del partido en ese momento", escribió el guardameta, uno de los capitanes del equipo ilicitano. Dituro, que cumple su cuarta temporada en la entidad, desveló que ya había trasladado sus disculpas a sus compañeros y al cuerpo técnico "en privado" antes de dirigirse públicamente a la afición del Elche, "sobre todo a los que cruzaron media España" para acompañar al equipo en Cantabria, entre ellos su mujer y sus dos hijos. El portero agradeció además el esfuerzo de sus compañeros, que "a pesar de la situación adversa, intentaron hasta el final levantar un resultado duro". "De esta me levantaré más fuerte y voy a trabajar incansablemente para ayudar al equipo", añadió Dituro. "Esto es Elche. De esto se trata la vida, aceptar lo que sucedió, aprender, trabajar, levantarse, corregir y seguir adelante", sentenció.
